access.notes: Any plane-wave DFT implementation with PAW pseudopotentials and GGA is acceptable. Quantum ESPRESSO is open-source; VASP is commercial but widely available.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials for Ce and Te (GGA)

access.notes: Standard GGA PAW sets, e.g. Ce.rel-pbe-spn-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF and Te.rel-pbe-dn-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF. Also available from the SSSP library at Materials Cloud.
